test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

Superstitions are still believed in.

options.text: People are still believing in superstitions.
People still can believe in superstitions.

solution: The correct answer is **'People still believe in superstitions'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is in Passive Voice. As per the question we have to change it into Active Voice. • The structure of the given sentence is as follows: • Subject + V1 + Object. (Active Voice) • Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V3 + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice) • *Example:* • *Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice) * • *English is taught by Aastha. (Passive Voice)* • The subject of the given sentence is 'Superstitions'. • The object of the given sentence is 'People (Hidden object)'. • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. • 'are believed' will be changed into 'believe'. Correct Sentence:__ *People still believe in superstitions.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य **Passive Voice** में है। प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे **Active Voice** में बदलना है। • दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है: • Subject + V1 + Object. (Active Voice) • Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V3 + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice) • *Example:* • *Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice) * • *English is taught by Aastha. (Passive Voice)* • दिए गए वाक्य का विषय** 'Superstitions'** है। • दिए गए वाक्य का उद्देश्य **'People (Hidden object)' **है। • **Object** के स्थान पर **Subject** रखा जाएगा और **Subject** के स्थान पर **Object** रखी जाएगी। • **'are believed' **को **'believe' **में बदल दिया जाएगा। df:T1449, The correct answer is **'Let the advisory be issued to the villagers to be on alert for the cyclone'.**
